[ff6464]No! I'm falling! Nooooo!!![ffffff]
You can collect sweets for me? Yay!\nOkay, now I'll tell you the ones I need.\nBe sure to remember all correctly, won't you?
Well, I like well-baked sweets.\nSo, firstly, get 10 [ffff64]Pumpkin Cookies[ffffff] for me, please.
So, the second one is 10 [ffff64]Jack Puddings[ffffff].\nAnd then... Too many, you say?\nYou want me to curse again, huh?
Just stop whining and let's get to the third one.\nThey're all sweet, so I need something salty.\n10 [ffff64]Pumpkin Soup[ffffff]. That's it! Thanks in advance.
Hey! How did it go? You've collected sweets?\n...Awww, not yet? It's not so hard, right?\nMeh. Hurry up.
Thank you so much!! You've got all the sweets!\nGood luck on collecting sweets for them!

The second one tastes super hot at first but\nsoon it tastes slightly sweet and I really like\nit! 10 [ffff64]Zombie Cakes[ffffff], please!
Have you collected the sweets? Hurry up, pom.\nWhat's the reward? That's secret.\nI promise you won't be disappointed, pom.

Olant! Potumkin!
Oh, Jacky!\nYou're kind enough to come to see me today too...
The witch is preparing for making sweets since\nlast evening.\nWe wanna get outta here right now...
Hold on. The guest of our attr...\nThe guest is gonna help us save you.
The cage is tightly locked by the chains...
Looks like the chains are enchanted with magic and\nyou cannot cut them with normal weapons and tools...
Whaaat?! There's nothing we can do?!\nOh, come on...
Pommm, I thought you could do something with it...
What should we do now...
Blacksmiths or synthesists in towns may know how to\ncut the enchanted chains...
What?! Someone in your world may know how to solve\nthis?! I'll go with you! I wanna help them quickly.\nOlant, Potumkin, you guys heard that?
We'll go to another world with the guest and find\nthe way to cut the chains, so hang on.\nI promise I'll get you guys out of the cage!!
I got it.\nBe careful on your way.
ASAP, pom!
Let's [ffff64]ask blacksmiths[ffffff] if they have the tools to\ncut the enchanted chains...
Jacky! Guest!\nYou're back, finally!
She can cut the chains, pom?\nPlease let us out of here now, pom!
Shhh. The witch may notice us!\nWe need to look into the magic on the chain first,\nso hold on a minute.
Now! Now!
Shut up!! Come on, Ms. Filecia.
This is... I got it.\nMagic paint of sealing is used on the chains...
Whoa! You've got what kind of magic it is already?!
Yes. If my guess is right, we can dispel the magic\neffect of magic paint like this with Shamhna Powder.
We need to [ffff64]get the materials[ffffff] listed on here but\nthe only thing we should do is grind and mix\nafter collecting them. So, it should be easy.
We can get all of them in our world.\nDon't forget the numbers and types of them.\nWell, I must be going...
H-Hey, wait wait.\nYou're not gonna help us make the powder?!
As I said, you just need to grind and stir them.\nYou won't need my help.
And I have to mess with the upstart girl in Sofya...
I'm pretty interested in you, so I'll visit here\nagain. Good luck!
So many strange people in your world...\nAnyway, the Sham... what was that?\nLet's go find the materials.
Oh, Jacky! You've got the materials?
Lemme outta here...
I'm sorry, not yet.\nThe guest is trying to collect them all, so wait\na little longer.
Hmm, if you say so...
Collect them before we're turned into sweets...\nI beg you...
Count on us. We'll save you and she'll be\nlaughing on the wrong side of her face!\nHang on. Okay now, let's go.
Welcome back, pom!\nWe've been waiting for you, pom!!
Now we can get out of this cage!\nCut the chains off now!!
Alright, alright. Hold on a second.\nI'll make the powder. Would you hand over the\nmaterials, please?
As Filecia said, you ground and mixed them...\nShamhna Powder has been made!
Yaaaaay!!
Finally, I'm out of the cage!!
I was so scared, pom!!
You see? The witch! Olant and Potumkin are back!\nSay something if you can!!
Neener neener! Come on!
Gyaaahhh!!
Aieeee....
We might get caught again, pom!!
Retreat! Hurry, right now!!
Come on, witch!
We're here to make you pay for putting us into the\ncage!
Fight us, pom!
What a nuisance! Who's that?!
Y-You're the witch in this castle??
That's right! I am Jeila the great witch and the\nlord of this castle!! You're the ingredients that\nran away, right?! That'll save the trouble!
What a small witch... Hee hee hee.\nWe can beat her! Olant, Potumkin, come on!!
Yeaaa!!
Agggghhhh?!
How could ingredients of sweets run away...\nNow I'll make what I wanna eat!
We might've messed up... We're not scared!\nWe have a strong adventurer!\nWe will fight together and beat you up!!
Aha... You're gonna help the ingredients? Heh!\nYou'll regret that. Bring it on!!
Jeila (Lv50)
Aaaaaahhh! I'm so sorrrrry!\nI... I just wanted to have sweeeeets!\nPlease don't stomp me!
Don't cry, pom.\nWe'll give you some sweets if you like...
So, don't say you're gonna eat us.\nWe were scared when we were in the cage just like\nyou are now. You understand this, right?
Yes... I'm so sorry.\nPlease forgive me...
If you promise you won't do such a thing, yes.
Pom!
I promise! I'll never do this again!!
After all the torture...?\n...Well, they say they forgive you.\nThen, I'll forgive you...
Thanks for your help.\nIt became a thrilling attraction though we didn't\nintend to do. Did you have fun? ...That's good!
I'm sorry for making trouble.\nThis is my token of apology and thank-you gift\nfrom them...
I guess you can't come here so often but I believe\nwe can meet again like this.\nLet's play with us then!
I miss you...
Look after yourself, pom!
We'll think about new attractions for all of us\nto enjoy. So, come again. Take care of yourself!
I'm glad you enjoyed it pretty much!
Now, what kind of attraction are we gonna make\nnext...?
Look forward to it!!
Difficulty: Normal has been added to\nBOSS: Jeila.
Pom! It's the guest who saved us!
Oh, right. One year has past and you came here?
No way, idiot. The wormhole to another world is\nstill open. Haven't you go back to your world, yet?
...Oh, I see. Well, it's nice cuz we can ask\nyou a favor. Is that okay for you? Then, I wanna\nask you to collect sweets.
What? ...Oh, you're scared of the curse?\nNo worries. We won't do that again.
You saved our lives. You're our important guest.\nWe'll treat you nicely. But if you collect sweets\nfor us, we'll treat you more nicely.
We'll give you something good if you collect\nsweets, so please, pom.
You are in no particular hurry.\nLet's accept this.
Yay!!
Hm? You're...\nThis should be the right time. I need to confirm\nyour combat skills. Fight me!
...What? You accepted their request to collect\nsweets?! You're... awesome!!
They promised me to share sweets.\nIf you collect sweets, my share will be better\nthan expected.
Go collect them. But come here again and fight me\nif you feel like it... Yes, it's a promise. Okay?
Thank you for playing with me.\nYou're the first one who beat me like this.\nYou're awesome.
Come to this castle and play with me next year.\nI'll have lots of sweets and get stronger.
Few people can come to here so many times but\nI feel we can meet again like this.\nLet's play with us again then!
I miss you...
Look after yourself, pom!
We'll think about new attractions for all of us\nto enjoy. So, come again. Take care of yourself!
I'm glad you enjoyed it pretty much!
Now, what kind of attraction are we gonna make\nnext...?
Look forward to it!!
